process_area.title: Technology Investment Planning, Budgeting & TBM Framework

value_stream.name: Technology Business Management, IT Financial Management & Cloud FinOps

fields.Participants: CFO (links to VS-17.4), CIO (VS-27), EA (VS-113), ITAM (VS-99), Finance (VS-17)
fields.Volume: Enterprise technology spend (≈ PHP 0.6B–1.9B/yr across 5 entities)

workflows.name: Technology Business Management (TBM) Framework & Cost Taxonomy

Automation Opportunity: - Automated spend ingestion from vendors/bank/GL into the TBM taxonomy
Controls: - CTL-635 (ensure controlled execution — Technology Investment Planning, Budgeting & TBM Framework (PA-135.1).)
- CTL-635: TBM taxonomy approved by CFO/CIO; reconciliation to GL monthly
Cross-references: - links to VS-17 (finance), VS-113 (EA), VS-99 (ITAM), VS-72 (interentity)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Invisible-spend risk**: Technology spend scattered, un-tracked; mitigated by single taxonomy and complete mapping
- **Taxonomy-drift risk**: Categories inconsistent over time; mitigated by governance and annual review
System Touchpoints: - TBM platform/ITFM tool; GL/COA (VS-17/VS-29); application portfolio (VS-113); ITAM (VS-99); interentity (VS-72)

steps.activity: FinOps Lead establish the TBM cost taxonomy (infrastructure, application, cloud/SaaS, telco/network, vendor services, people) mapped to business units, capabilities, and the application portfolio (VS-113)
FinOps Lead map all technology spend into the taxonomy (incl. interentity allocation links to VS-72), define the cost-to-serve metrics, and align to the GL/COA (links to VS-17/VS-29)
FinOps Lead publish the TBM framework, onboard new spend, and review annually with Finance and the executive team

fields.Participants: Finance (VS-17.4), CIO office, function sponsors, EA (VS-113), OpEx (VS-133)
fields.Volume: Enterprise technology budget (run vs grow vs transform)

workflows.name: Annual IT Budget Planning, Zero-Based & Capacity-Based Budgeting

Automation Opportunity: - Capacity-based budget modeling from usage trends; forecast-vs-actual automation
Controls: - CTL-635 (ensure controlled execution — Technology Investment Planning, Budgeting & TBM Framework (PA-135.1).)
- CTL-635: budget approved by CFO/Board; variance reviewed quarterly
Pain Points / Risks: - **Under-provision risk**: Usage-driven spend under-budgeted; mitigated by capacity modeling and FinOps (W4106)
- **Run-grows-out-of-control risk**: Run-cost crowds out grow/transform; mitigated by zero-based review and rationalization (W4103)
System Touchpoints: - TBM (W4097); FP&A (VS-17.4); corporate performance (VS-33); cloud/SaaS billing (W4106)

steps.activity: FinOps Lead/CIO build the annual IT budget (run-the-business, grow, transform), with zero-based review of discretionary lines and capacity-based modeling for usage-driven cloud/SaaS/telco
FinOps Lead align the budget to the investment portfolio (W4099) and corporate FP&A (VS-17.4/VS-33), and reforecast quarterly against actuals (W4117)
FinOps Lead present the budget to the executive/Board (VS-36), manage trade-offs, and cascade accountability to budget owners

fields.Volume: Enterprise tech investment portfolio (ERP, omnichannel, AI, renewable-tech, statutory)

Controls: - CTL-635 (ensure controlled execution — Technology Investment Planning, Budgeting & TBM Framework (PA-135.1).)
- CTL-635: capex/opex classification reviewed by Finance; investment approval per authority matrix (VS-40)
Cross-references: - links to VS-40 (capex), VS-112 (PMO), VS-113 (EA), VS-134 (OCM)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Mis-classification risk**: Capex/opex errors distort financials; mitigated by Finance review (links to VS-40)
- **Portfolio-bloat risk**: Too many investments, none finishing; mitigated by portfolio governance with PMO

steps.activity: FinOps Lead/CIO maintain the technology investment portfolio, classify capex vs opex (links to VS-40 capex accounting), and align to the corporate capex envelope and strategy (VS-33)
FinOps Lead/EA ensure investments are architecture-aligned (VS-113), de-duplicated, and sequenced with OCM (VS-134) and PMO (VS-112)
FinOps Lead track investment progress and benefit realization (W4113), and report to the capex/investment committee and Board (VS-40/VS-36)

fields.Participants: Finance (VS-17.4), sponsor, EA (VS-113), ITAM (VS-99), OpEx benefit (VS-133 W4065)

workflows.name: Business Case, TCO & ROI Modeling for Technology Initiatives

Automation Opportunity: - TCO templates with industry benchmarks; sensitivity modeling
Controls: - CTL-635 (ensure controlled execution — Technology Investment Planning, Budgeting & TBM Framework (PA-135.1).)
- CTL-635: business case approved by Finance; benefit reconciled post-implementation
Cross-references: - links to VS-17.4 (finance), VS-133 W4065 (benefit), VS-40 (capex), VS-99 (ITAM)
Pain Points / Risks: - **TCO-blind risk**: Upfront cost only, ignoring run/hidden costs; mitigated by full TCO discipline
- **Overstate-benefit risk**: Rosy benefit case; mitigated by Finance sign-off and realization tracking
System Touchpoints: - TBM (W4097); benefit tracking (VS-133 W4065); capex (VS-40); ITAM lifecycle (VS-99)

steps.activity: FinOps Lead build the TCO (license/subscription, cloud, integration, implementation, support, telco, end-of-life) and the benefit case (revenue, cost, risk, productivity) with Finance sign-off
FinOps Lead model ROI/NPV/payback, test sensitivity, and document assumptions/risks; align benefit tracking to VS-133 W4065
FinOps Lead track realized TCO/ROI against the case post-implementation (links to W4113), and feed lessons into future cases

fields.Participants: Business sponsors, IT (VS-27), EA (VS-113), PMO (VS-112), OpEx (VS-133)
fields.Volume: Enterprise IT demand (new requests, enhancements, support)

Automation Opportunity: - Intake workflow; demand-vs-capacity analytics; automated scoring
Controls: - CTL-635 (ensure controlled execution — Technology Investment Planning, Budgeting & TBM Framework (PA-135.1).)
- CTL-635: demand prioritization criteria; architecture-fit check
Cross-references: - links to VS-27 (IT), VS-113 (EA), VS-112 (PMO), W4112 (shadow IT)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Shadow-IT risk**: Un-met demand drives shadow IT (W4112); mitigated by responsive, transparent intake
- **Loudest-voice risk**: Prioritization skewed by influence not value; mitigated by standardized scoring
System Touchpoints: - Demand/intake tool; EA (VS-113); PMO (VS-112); service desk (VS-27.1)

steps.activity: IT operate a single demand intake (new systems, enhancements, integrations, analytics), capture business case (W4100), and triage
IT prioritize demand against capacity, strategy (VS-33), architecture fit (VS-113), and benefit; sequence with OCM (VS-134) and PMO (VS-112)
IT communicate decisions, manage expectations, and feed approved demand into delivery (VS-27/VS-112/VS-113)

fields.Trigger: TBM framework; monthly close; allocation review
fields.Volume: Enterprise technology cost allocation (5 entities, business units, capabilities)

workflows.name: Technology Cost Allocation, Showback / Chargeback to Business Units

Automation Opportunity: - Automated allocation engine; unit-cost dashboards for business units
Controls: - CTL-635 (ensure controlled execution — Technology Investment Planning, Budgeting & TBM Framework (PA-135.1).)
- CTL-635: allocation rules approved by CFO; reconciled to GL
Pain Points / Risks: - **Allocation-war risk**: Business units dispute allocations; mitigated by transparent drivers and showback-first
- **Gaming risk**: Allocation drivers distort behavior; mitigated by balanced, reviewed drivers

steps.activity: FinOps Lead define allocation rules (headcount, revenue, usage, transaction volume) per cost pool, aligned to TBM (W4097) and interentity rules (VS-72)
FinOps Lead run showback/chargeback monthly (showback by default; chargeback where agreed), publish unit-cost metrics to business units, and reconcile to GL (VS-17/W4117)
FinOps Lead review allocation fairness with business units, refine drivers, and use insights to drive demand/cost behavior

fields.Participants: EA (VS-113), IT (VS-27), ITAM (VS-99), business owners, OpEx (VS-133)
fields.Trigger: Annual portfolio review; redundancy/duplication; high run-cost
fields.Volume: Enterprise application portfolio (cloud ERP + ~10+ integrations + perimeter apps)

Automation Opportunity: - Usage/value auto-scoring from telemetry; dependency mapping
Controls: - CTL-635 (ensure controlled execution — Technology Investment Planning, Budgeting & TBM Framework (PA-135.1).)
- CTL-635: retire decisions via architecture governance; data-retention before decommission (VS-88/VS-91)
Cross-references: - links to VS-113 (EA), VS-99 (ITAM), VS-88/VS-91 (records/privacy), VS-134 (OCM)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Sentimental-app risk**: Low-value apps kept alive; mitigated by objective TIME scoring
- **Retire risk**: Retiring an app with hidden dependencies; mitigated by dependency analysis (VS-113)
System Touchpoints: - Application portfolio (VS-113); ITAM (VS-99); TBM run-cost (W4097); benefit (W4113)

steps.activity: EA/IT Finance assess the application portfolio (business value, technical fit, run-cost, usage, redundancy, risk) using TIME (Tolerate/Invest/Migrate/Eliminate) framing
EA/IT Finance identify rationalization actions (consolidate, retire, replace, renegotiate), build the business case (W4100), and sequence with OCM (VS-134)
EA/IT Finance execute retire/consolidate, capture run-cost savings (W4113), and update the architecture (VS-113) and ITAM (VS-99)

fields.Trigger: Renewal cycle; new project; usage review
fields.Volume: Enterprise software/SaaS estate (~6,762 potential users + devices)

Controls: - CTL-635: entitlement inventory maintained; compliance verified before audit
Cross-references: - links to VS-99 (ITAM/SAM), VS-34 (procurement), VS-21 (audit), W4110 (SaaS utilization)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Over-buy risk**: Paying for unused licenses; mitigated by usage-based right-sizing (W4110)
- **Audit-exposure risk**: Under-licensing triggers vendor audit/penalty; mitigated by entitlement governance and true-ups
System Touchpoints: - ITAM/SAM tool (VS-99); usage telemetry (W4110); procurement (VS-34); TBM (W4097)

steps.activity: ITAM/IT Finance maintain the entitlement inventory (licenses, subscriptions, seats, true-ups, co-terms), map to actual usage (W4110), and forecast demand
ITAM/Procurement optimize entitlement (right-size seats, tier optimization, co-term/renewal consolidation, negotiate) before renewal, with procurement controls (VS-34)
ITAM/IT Finance manage compliance (avoid under-licensing/audit exposure links to VS-99/VS-21), capture savings (W4113), and update ITAM
